_meta.source: TheDuchessFlame — Burning Springs Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase guides
_meta.note: ***Subject to change pending porting to live servers***

name: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases
blurb: Every Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase spawn in Burning Springs, in route order. Follow the numbered path — most spawns lead directly to the next. Tick each one off as you collect it.

locations.directions: From the spawn in location, face North, jump over the dried river bed, and head toward the green tent. Jump up onto the roof of the tent and face northwest. Run forward, veering slightly right, until you reach the open shack with the tin roof. The briefcase is on the ground under the metal shelf on your right.

From the spawn above, stand on top of the green trailer and face southeast. You’ll see the start of a dried river bed in front of you. Run straight across until you reach the rock face on the other side. Turn left and follow the river bed for a bit until you reach a split. You’ll know you’re in the right spot if you’re standing in the middle of the lead deposit.

From the middle of the lead deposit, face North and follow the river bed upward. Keep to the left when you pass the tree stump on your right. At the end of the river bed, you’ll come to a small scene with a raider corpse, some brain fungus, and a few skeletons. Walk over and stand next to the raider corpse, then face West. The briefcase is on the rock in front of you, slightly to your right.

From the spawn above, turn around and run back down to the lead deposit. From the middle of the deposit, face south and follow the river bed until you reach the collapsed bridge and the destroyed train carriages. You’ll see the support bars and frame of the bridge in front of you. Walk over to the support bar in the middle. The briefcase is on the left side, half covered in the red powder.

From the spawn above, face south and walk through the train carriage. Keep moving in a straight line and jump or jetpack up the hill in front of you. Stop at the top when you’re looking out over Athens.

Look down and you’ll see a dome-shaped shed ahead. Run over to the shed and enter through the door on the right. The briefcase is on the ground to your left, between the two metal shelves.

From the spawn in location, face South and run forward until you reach the main road. Turn East and head toward the ruined house ahead. Walk inside and look down. The briefcase is sitting in a hole in the floorboards, half buried in the dirt.

From the spawn above, face South and drop back down to the main road. Turn and follow the road East, going through the train carriage, until you reach the brick house beside the yellow house on your left. Stop at the front of the brick house and face South. Walk forward, drop down to the road, and continue through the pit of burnt ghouls and skeletons. Keep going until you reach the metal temporary fencing.

Face East and walk along the fence with it on your left. You’ll see a skeleton holding the briefcase beneath an Abraxo sign painted on the wall.

From the spawn above, face south and look at the building in front of you. You’ll see two windows and then a hole in the wall beside them. Jump or jetpack across the gap and enter through the hole. Turn right and go into the next room. The briefcase is on the kitchen counter against the east wall.

From the spawn above, face south and walk through the hole in the wall. Keep going straight until you reach the edge of the roof. Look down and you’ll see a three-story building in front of you with a red and white striped awning on the left.

Drop down from the roof, walk straight ahead, and enter that building through the front door. Turn right and follow the counter to the end, then face southwest. Walk over to the last red shelf on your right. The briefcase is on the other side of the shelving unit.

From the spawn above, face West and walk forward past the chain link fence. Stop at the stone wall on the corner. Face South and move slightly to the left until you’re standing at the edge of the basketball court. With the chain link fence on your right, follow it forward. You’ll see the briefcase under the streetlight ahead of you.

From the spawn above, face South and stand in the gap in the chain link fence. Walk straight with the brick building on your left. Jump over the small fence and continue south until you reach the green rubbish bin, on your left, next to some metal crates. The briefcase is on the ground, between the bin and the crates.

From the spawn above, face South and follow the platform to the end. Jump over the fence and turn left. Follow the stairs down and stop in the middle of the riverbed. Face East and walk forward until you’re standing under the concrete bridge.

Turn northwest and look up. You’ll see a dirt ledge in front of you. Jump or jetpack up to the ledge. The briefcase is in front of you, next to a pile of wood and a corpse.

From the spawn above, run around and stand on top of the bridge facing Athens. Follow the road North and either open or jump over the gate. Keep following the road North and stop at the green streetlight on your right, in front of the stage.

Turn right and jump up onto the stage. Face East, walk forward a few steps, and stop in the doorway to the back area. The briefcase will be on your right, between some metal crates and a red armchair.

From the spawn above, face East, then turn left and stop at the bottom of the ramp. Walk forward and stop on the other side of the brick and wrought iron fence. Turn right and follow the fence until you reach the brick column entrance.

Face northeast and look up. You should just be able to see the top of a diner ahead. Jump or jetpack up the ledge and stop in the alleyway between the brick building and the diner. Follow the alley north and enter the door at the end. Follow the room around. The briefcase is on one of the tables on your right.

From the spawn above, face East, walk through the door, and continue straight until you reach the car park stairs. Follow the stairs to the top and face South. Jump over to the platform in front of you, then cross the bridge on your right to reach the building on the other side.

Face northwest and you’ll see a wooden shack ahead. Walk over and stand in front of the blue couch. Face South. The briefcase is on the small bookcase in front of you at the end of the room.

From the spawn above, turn around and walk back to the top of the car park stairs next to the green rubbish bin. Make sure the green rubbish bin is on your left. Face East and walk down the makeshift ramp (not the actual car park ramp). At the bottom is a hole in the floor. Drop down through the hole (you will drop down 2 levels).

Face West and you’ll see a rusty jeep in front of you. Walk around to the back of the jeep and keep facing West. The briefcase is on the metal cabinet in front of you, near the fire barrel.

From the spawn above, follow the row of metal cabinets to the end and face East. You’ll see a hole in the floor. Drop down to the next level and face East again. There will be a door in front of you leading out of the car park. Walk through the door and continue straight until you reach the dead grass hedge beside the house ahead.

Face south, walk forward, and stop on the main road. Face east, run to the bus, and go inside. The briefcase is in the back of the bus on the left seat.

From the spawn above, exit the bus and face West. Follow the road and stop at the base of the stairs that lead up to the roof of the bus. Turn South and follow the white line on the path until you reach the broken stone wall on your right. Face West and walk straight toward the white tents. The briefcase is on the picnic table in front of you, in front of the white tent.

From the spawn above, stand on the picnic table and face West. Jump up onto the roof in front of you and turn left. Follow the roof to the end and go up the stairs. Turn left again, and the briefcase will be in front of you on the right, leaning against the wooden crates.

From the spawn above, get up onto the roof of the building you’re standing in. You can jetpack up, climb the ledges, or take the stairs on the eastern side and loop around from there.

Once you’re on the roof, head to the wooden bridge and red armchair in the northwest corner. Turn south and walk forward until you reach the edge of the roof, then drop down onto the platform below. The briefcase is on the table to your left, between two teddy bears watching the world burn.

From the spawn above, face South and run, jump, or jetpack all the way across to the road on the other side. Enter the red shipping container, and the briefcase will be on the pile of wooden crates in front of you.

From the spawn above, stand on top of the shipping container and face West. You’ll see a bus and then a red metal bridge in the distance. Run over to the red bridge and stop at the left end, near the single house. While standing at the end of the bridge, face West and walk straight to the house. The briefcase is on a pile of wooden crates against the wall in front of you.
From the spawn above, face North and jump into the river. Turn left and follow the river until you reach the raft with the blue sail. The briefcase is on the edge of the raft.
From the spawn above, continue following the river south and stop at the rusty cars between the two edges of the broken bridge. The briefcase is in the boot of the last car in the pile.

From the spawn above, continue following the river South until you reach the red canoe on your left. At the canoe, face southeast and walk forward past the jungle gym and play equipment. Stop when you reach the outdoor grill and picnic table on your left. The briefcase is inside the outdoor grill.

From the spawn above, face south, and you’ll see a light yellow sand path leading up the hill. Walk over to the path and follow it straight, go down the stairs, and stop when you reach the white metal door. There are a lot of enemies here, so it’s easiest to jump over the fence in front of you, clear the area, then return to the white door at the bottom of the stairs.

Open the white door and head South. Stop at the cooking station on your right. Face West and you’ll see the dome shed behind the cooking station. The briefcase is just inside the shed on your right.

From the spawn above, face South and follow the path. Veer slightly left and continue along the path. Do not enter any of the buildings. At the end of the path, there is a gap between the fence and the rock wall. Walk through the gap, stop on the other side, and face East. Walk straight until you reach the path, then turn right. Take a few steps forward and you’ll see the briefcase inside the pipe on your right, under the skeleton.

From the spawn above, face northeast and follow the yellow sand path. Stop at the base of the wooden stairs on your left. Face southeast and continue along the path. At the next split, veer left and head up the wooden stairs. Stop at the top and face East. You’ll see a handmade windmill on the hill ahead. Run up to the windmill. The briefcase is on the ground between a blue metal barrel and a yellow plastic barrel.

From the spawn above, face South and run straight. Jump off the ledge and land on the yellow sand path below. Face East and follow the path down the hill. The path ends at the top of a rock face. Jump off and veer right toward the small brick building with the red-edged roof. The briefcase is around the front of the building, leaning against the Nuka-Cola machine and behind the metal trash can.

From the spawn in location, head toward the diner and enter through the white wooden door. Face south and move behind the counter directly ahead. The briefcase is on the floor behind the counter, leaning against the western wall.

From the spawn above, turn around and leave the diner through the same front door. Stop on the main road, turn left, and follow it all the way to the end. The briefcase is inside the collapsed tunnel, next to the corpse and the blue Abraxo plastic barrels.

Level 0 Locked Door

From the spawn above, exit the tunnel and follow the road to the closest pole of the billboard. Face west, and you’ll see a path leading up the hill along with the top of a streetlight. Run up the hill and stop in the middle of the road. Still facing west, you’ll see a water tower ahead. Run to the water tower and stop at the shed at its base. Unlock the door and go inside. The briefcase is on the ground in front of the console and the broken terminal.

Level 0 Locked Door

From the spawn above, face east and walk back out to the main road. Follow the road east for a few meters and jump onto the back of the red truck trailer. Face south and, if you have it unlocked, head toward the Hocking Hills Train Station map marker. Stop at the edge of the cliff and look down. There should be a road to your left. Drop down onto the road and face north. Walk over and unlock the red door. The briefcase is inside the tunnel, against the west wall, sitting in the shopping trolley next to the wood pile.

From the spawn above, exit the tunnel and take a few steps forward, then face east. You may need to move slightly to the right until you're past the tunnel walls and looking out over open ground. Run forward and stop when you reach the train tracks. Turn north and follow the tracks until you reach the overturned train carriage on your right. Face east. The briefcase is next to a pile of wooden crates and a skeleton on your right.

From the spawn above, head back to the train tracks and face south. Follow the tracks until you reach the train station. Do not enter the station. Keep following the tracks, keeping them on your right, and stop at the guard post on your left. Face east and walk up the guard post stairs. Face southeast, and the briefcase will be inside the broken orange train carriage in front of you.
From the spawn above, face west and run into the train station. Face north. The briefcase is on the second row of seats, against the east wall.

From the spawn above, face west and walk out the door, continuing west until you reach the main road. Turn left and follow the road south until you see buildings on your right. Turn west and head to the building with the blue car parked out front. Open the white door on the left side of the building. The briefcase is leaning against the west wall, next to the toilet.
From the spawn above, exit the building and face south. To your right is a white wooden shack (dugout). Walk over to the dugout. The briefcase is just inside, on one of the seats to your left.

From the spawn above, face East and run straight ahead. Jump over the bleachers and continue until you reach the main road. Turn right and follow the road for a while. Cross over the train tracks and keep following the road until you reach the first house on your left.

Stop in front of that house. Face toward it and walk toward the red doghouse on the left side of the yard. The briefcase is inside the doghouse.

Level 0 Locked Door

From the spawn above, turn around and head back to the main road. Follow the road east until you see a green trailer on your left. Turn left and take the path behind the trailer. It leads to a white shed at the back. Unlock the shed door and go inside. The briefcase is on your left, sitting on top of the BBQ.

From the spawn above, face southwest and look uphill. You’ll see a ruined house on the other side of the road. Run up the hill to that house. The briefcase is in the back of the rusty van on your right.

From the spawn above, face the house and move around to the back door. With the back door behind you, face west. Run straight across the open plain and up the hill on the other side. As you climb the hill, you’ll see a crashed blue plane on your left.

The briefcase is leaning against the blue section of the plane, next to the skeleton pilot, on the right-hand side.

From the spawn above, face southeast, and you’ll see a ruined house in the distance. Run over to the house and go inside. Head into the kitchen and then turn to face the front door. The briefcase is under the table, next to one of the skeletons.

From the spawn above, exit the house and head to the main road. Face south and look uphill. You’ll see a red truck trailer and a “Jackson Junkyard” sign ahead of you, with a dirt path on your right. Follow the path past the trailer and continue through Gap Ridge.

At the end of the gap, you’ll come to a “Danger Cliff Edge Stay Away” sign and an open truck trailer. Go inside the trailer. The briefcase is on the pallet to your right, next to an ammo bag and a radio.

From the spawn above, jump onto the trailer and face South. You’ll get a clear view of the junkyard. In the distance, look for the orange canvas tents along the back wall on the left side of the yard. Stay as far south as you can and run straight toward those tents.

When you reach the orange tents, you’ll spot a green wooden shed on your right. Turn east and head inside through the door. The briefcase is sitting on the bottom shelf of the metal rack on your left, just inside the entrance.

From the spawn above, jump onto the shed and face South. You’ll see a gap in the wall straight ahead. Drop down and leave the yard through the gap. Stop there and face South again. Run forward until you hit the main road. Turn left and you’ll spot a bus shelter on your right.

The briefcase is inside the shelter, under the bench and the skeleton, right in front of you.

From the spawn in location, face North and run over to the guard house on your left. Stop at the gate and turn to face North East. Walk forward and climb into the APC in front of you. The briefcase is on the bench on your right.
From the spawn above, exit the APC and face East. Head into the white wooden shed in front of you and keep facing East. The briefcase is sitting on top of a pile of wooden crates on your right.

From the spawn above, exit the shed and walk back over to the guard house. Jump onto the guard house and face South. Look up and you’ll see a water tower, with a dirt path running up the hill toward it. Run up the hill and stop where the dirt path begins. You should see a rock slide on your left, covering part of the path. Face North East, and the briefcase is half-buried in the dirt, hiding behind a large rock.

From the spawn above, face East and jump or jetpack up to the top of the hill. Face Southeast and walk forward until you reach the picnic area. On your left, you’ll see two picnic tables. Go to the one at the back with the metal plates leaning against it. The briefcase is on the right side of the table, tucked under one of the metal plates.
From the spawn above, face southwest and run over to the water tower. Use the barrels or a jetpack to get up onto the platform. The briefcase is sitting on the edge of the platform on the West side.

From the spawn above, stay on the platform and walk to the Southeast edge. Jump off the platform and walk forward at a normal pace. Go over the top of the curved rock, then drop off the cliff ledge. Turn south and you’ll see the briefcase in a small clearing with two corpses and a yellow first aid kit.

From the spawn above, face West and run straight forward. Go down the hill into the valley and stop when you reach the rock wall on the other side. Face North and follow the rock face along until you reach a small cave and a green metal door. The briefcase is leaning against the wall on your right, next to the green metal door.

And no, the door doesn’t open, and there’s nothing behind it. There are a few of these doors in this valley. You can’t open any of them, but they look like they’re set up for future content, similar to the TNT domes.

From the spawn above, face East and walk forward into the valley. Stop in the middle, then turn South and follow the valley until you reach the train wreck. Turn right and walk along the train carriages until you reach the green and blue shipping containers on your left. The briefcase is on the ground next to the green container, between two corpses.

From the spawn above, face North and follow the train track to the last cylinder carriage on your right. If you reach the one lying on its side, you’ve gone too far. Turn to face Southeast and line yourself up with the middle of the upright train cylinder. Jump over it and head straight up the hill. As you go down the other side, you’ll see a half-buried power pylon on your left connected to a yellow pipe joint. Walk to the pylon and face South. Move forward slowly until you see some broken concrete walls on your left. Head to the centre platform of the ruin. The briefcase is on the ground in the middle of the skeletons and corpses.

From the spawn above, jump back onto the platform and face East. You’ll see the large green rusty pipes on your right. Run forward, angling right until you’re moving alongside the pipes. Stop when you reach the red canvas roofs on your right. Turn to face Southeast, jump onto the canvas, then jump across to the platform beyond it. Turn to face South. The briefcase is in the orange metal cart in front of you.

Pick up the note on the table next to the couch to start an unmarked quest, or read the guide here.

From the spawn above, face south and look for the stairs behind the cart. Walk down and stop at the bottom. Keep facing South and walk forward past the yellow machine on your left. Stop at the large green rusty pipe behind it. Turn left and walk up the inside of the pipe, stopping in the middle. Face South and you’ll see a ladder and a doorway. Jump up and enter the small room. Turn left. The briefcase is on the makeshift shelves on your left, next to the ammo boxes.

From the spawn above, exit the small room and turn left. Walk to the bottom of the pipe and turn left again. Face South and follow the path until you reach the wooden gates. Open them and stop at the fire engine ahead. Jump onto the fire engine and face Southeast. Run forward, jump over the train carriage, and stop at the car being held up by the crane. The briefcase is under the car, on top of the wooden crates, on your right.

From the spawn above, face North East and walk over to the red shipping containers in front of you. Go up the stairs, turn to face East, walk forward, and angle slightly left so you’re moving along the top of the truck trailer. At the end of the trailer, you’ll see a large green rusty pipe rising upward.

If you have a jetpack, you can jump onto the pipe and then across to the next large green rusty pipe in front of you. If not, use the building on your right to climb up.

Follow the pipe north until it starts curving down toward the ground. Before you drop down, make sure you jump off to the left.

Once you’re on the ground, face southwest and walk to the room in the corner with the terminal on a desk outside the door. The briefcase is on the metal shelf next to the yellow first aid kit on your left.

From the spawn above, exit the room, walk forward a few steps, and jump onto the red canvas above you. Face South and jump up onto the wall. Turn East and jump onto the large green rusty pipe in front of you. Sadly, we still can’t climb ladders in this game. Face South and follow the pipe until you reach the wooden bridge on your left. Drop down into the bridge and enter the pipe at the end.

Follow this pipe until you reach the cut-out doorway. Turn to face East and walk to the edge of the roof. From here, you should be able to jump or jetpack over to the next building, or you can use the bridge on your left. Jump up again so you’re standing on the roof.

Keep heading East across the rooftops and stop when you reach a yellow wooden crate sitting on a pallet. Face North and drop down to the roof below. The briefcase will be at your feet next to three rusty metal barrels.

Level 1 Locked Door

From the spawn above, face East, walk forward a few steps, then turn North. Head toward the stairs and follow the catwalk straight ahead until you reach another set of stairs on your left. Go up those stairs and follow the walkway to the end. Jump down to the platform below and continue along the catwalk heading west until you reach a brick building. Turn left and follow the building around until you see the white metal door. Unlock the door, go inside, and turn right. The briefcase is on the metal shelf against the east wall.

The three numbered doors relate to the unmarked quest I mentioned above, so try and remember how to find this room again.

From the spawn in location, run straight toward the flaming deathclaw gate and stop at the fire barrel on your left. Next to the barrel is a ramp leading up to the top of the gate. Jump up the ramp and head south, then jump over the wall. When you land on the other side, stop. Look down, face West, and the briefcase will be sitting right under your nose.

From the spawn above, face North, jump over the wall, and run forward. Veer left until you’re on the main road heading away from the gate. Follow the road until you reach the “Highway Town” billboard. Turn right and walk behind it. Face East and you’ll spot a raider cage on a tall pole. Head over to the pole and walk slowly past it. The briefcase will be on the ground on your left, half tucked into a wooden bookcase next to the silver oven.

From the spawn above, turn around and run back to the front of the billboard. Face West and you’ll see two more raider cages on poles across the road. Run straight over to them and stop at the pile of cages on the ground. The briefcase will be on your left, half buried under the air-conditioning duct.

From the spawn in location, face South and you’ll see a cylinder train carriage ahead of you. Run over and jump onto the top of it. Keep moving across the carriages until you reach the small shed on your left. Veer left and go inside. The briefcase is on the metal shelf against the light blue shipping container.

From the spawn above, face south and exit the shed through the door in front of you. Turn southwest and walk to the front of the orange train carriage. Press the button on the wall and wait for the door to open. Head inside and continue forward until you reach the skeleton covered in plants. Look up and jump onto the catwalk above. Turn right, walk forward a few steps, then turn right again. Enter the blue metal building and follow it to the end. The briefcase is on the desk next to the broken terminal.

From the spawn above, turn around and follow the catwalk around, then drop back down to the skeleton covered in plants. Face northeast and walk to the blue door in the corner. Open it and break the boards blocking the way. Go down the stairs and stop at the bottom, then face East. Run and jump across to the brick building on the other side of the tracks. Don’t go inside. Instead, climb onto the roof above the door and face South. Walk through the hole in the wall and you’ll find the briefcase under the desk on your right.

From the spawn above, exit the building, face North, and run straight until you reach the last cylinder train carriage in the area, on your left. Turn toward the northeast and drop off the ledge as you walk forward. Go around the carriage until you find the entrance. Head inside, and the briefcase will be at the far end, next to the bed and the skeleton in the chair.

From the spawn above, exit the carriage and jump onto the roof. Face West and run forward until you reach the train tracks. Turn northwest and follow the tracks, keeping an eye on the hill to your left. When you spot a gap in the hillside, turn left and head toward it. Go into the gap and you’ll find the briefcase on your right, next to a corpse.

From the spawn above, turn around, leave the gap, and walk back to the train tracks. Turn left and follow the tracks until you see a blue canvas curtain on your left. Face West and walk over to the shelter. The briefcase is in the shopping trolley on your left, just outside the shelter.

From the spawn above, face southeast and run over to the train carriage. Jump up onto the green shipping container. Turn toward the northeast and walk forward until you reach a yellow dirt path. Face North and follow the path until you reach the tree blocking the way. The briefcase is under the fallen trunk.

From the spawn above, face North and look up. You’ll see a hill covered in statues of corn cobs. Head toward the hill and veer right, stopping at the bottom of the stairs on your right. Go up the stairs and follow the wooden path. Turn right and keep following the path to the end. Turn North and you’ll see the briefcase on the edge of the hole in front of you, near a green ammo bag and a corpse.

From the spawn above, face North and run to the white building in front of you. Go inside and turn left. Follow the room around and stop at the Employees Only door on your left. Open the door and go in. Walk around behind the desk, and the briefcase will be under it.
This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

From the spawn above, exit the room and turn left. Walk out of the building and jump up onto the roof of the building. Face West and you will see a playground in the distance.

Run over to the playground and look for the skeleton going down the slide. The briefcase is under the slide, leaning against the wooden tower.

From the spawn above, face North and walk over to the main road. Turn northeast and follow the road until the water tower comes into view on your left. Run over to it and stop at the small shed at the base of the tower. Go inside through the white door. The briefcase is on the ground, leaning against the desk along the southern wall.

From the spawn above, exit the shed and jump up onto the roof. Face northwest and you’ll spot a yellow dirt path leading uphill toward a farm, with grain silos visible on your right. Head to the dirt path and follow it all the way up to the farm. When you arrive, walk over to the shorter grain silo in front of you. The briefcase is sitting on a pile of pallets at the base of the silo.
This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

From the spawn above, look to your left for the red barn with the chained-shut door. Jump onto the roof of the barn and face northwest. Keep your line as straight as possible and run forward until you reach a rusty blue ute/pickup truck. Walk through the gap between the rock and the ute, then continue straight ahead. The briefcase is on the ground at the base of the tree on your right.

From the spawn in location, turn west and cross the wooden bridge. Follow the yellow dirt path and take the right-hand path when it splits. Continue up the path to the shed. Do not go inside. The briefcase is leaning against the right-hand side of the shed, in the garden bed.

From the spawn in location, run straight, go through the elevator platform, and stop at the campfire on the other side next to the brahmin pen on your right.

Face East, and the briefcase is on the back of the green car trailer, next to the metal barrel.

From the spawn above, face southwest and run over to the bus. Jump onto the roof and turn to face South. You’ll see a highway on-ramp ahead. Run over to it and follow the ramp upward. The briefcase is on the back seat of the limo near the top of the ramp.

From the spawn above, jump onto the limo and stand on the very edge of the bonnet. Jump the gap to the next section of the ramp and stop at the end.

Face North, walk down the wooden ramp, follow the path around, and stop at the top of the stairs. Turn West and walk straight, veering slightly right to get around the pillar in front of you. Interact with the door marked “Exit” and enter the Highway Town interior.

Once you load in, walk over to the stairs on your left and stop at the bottom. Face West and go into the shipping container ahead. The briefcase is on the ground on the right, leaning against a metal shelf and a wooden crate.

From the spawn above, exit the shipping container, turn southwest, and walk back to the exit door. Go through it to leave the building.

Face northeast and follow the path. Go up the stairs, turn right, head up the ramp, and keep following the path all the way to the end until you reach the guard post.

Face West and either take the stairs or jetpack up to the next floor. Stop at the bottom of the stairs and turn right. Walk forward to the railing at the edge. Turn left, go up the next set of stairs, and stop at the bar. The briefcase is behind the bar on the metal shelf in the corner.

From the spawn above, face southeast and go up the stairs in front of you. Follow the path west, jump over the rail at the end, and stop at the red and blue flowers in the middle.

Face South and walk over to the metal trailer ahead. Open the door and turn right. The briefcase is on the metal shelf at the end of the trailer.

From the spawn above, exit the trailer and close the door. Face east and go up the stairs in front of you. Walk forward, jump the gap, and land on the roof of the next building. Drop through the hole in the roof and face west. Take a few steps forward and stop at the bottom of the stairs. Face south and walk to the window. Turn east and follow the path around, and you’ll find the briefcase on the wooden bookcase in front of you.

From the spawn above, turn around and go back to the stairs. Go up the stairs, exit the building, and face South. Walk all the way to the railing and look down. You can jetpack down, jump onto the ramp and work your way down, climb into your power armour and do a superhero landing, or, if you line it up properly, shift slightly left and jump straight into the water.

Once you’re back on the ground, face North and walk over to the water purifiers. Turn East and you’ll see the briefcase floating in the water in front of you.

From the motorbike statue, face South and either jump over or walk around the statue, then look up. Jump onto the platform above, go inside the room, and turn left.

You’ll see a locked metal door ahead. There’s a keypad on the wall to the left and a puzzle on the right that gives you the code for the keypad.

You can solve the puzzle, or you can use the code listed at the very bottom of this guide.

Once the door is open, the briefcase is on the table to your right.

From the spawn above, turn around, exit the room, and drop back down to the ground floor. Walk back to the motorbike statue and face East. Move forward, veering slightly right to get around the wall, and stop on the other side. Face North and drop down to the floor below. Turn North, and the briefcase will be in front of you on the ground, between the stairs and the shipping container.

From the spawn above, turn and go back up the stairs. Face West and take the path on the right. Walk forward, go past the motorbike statue, and slowly look up as you move. Stop when you reach the bathtub hanging from the roof on your right. Turn North and jump up to the platform above. Face West, walk forward, and stop at the last bedroom on your right. Go inside and turn left. The briefcase is leaning against the yellow chair on the western wall.

From the spawn above, turn around, exit the room, and drop back down to ground level. Walk forward a few steps and turn West. Follow the path straight, veering slightly left to get around the wall. Stop when you reach The Last Resort and face southeast. Walk over to the gun vendor in front of you and use the door on the left to get behind the counter. Head to the southern corner and go into the room. The briefcase is under the bed, sitting on a wooden crate.

From the spawn in location, face West and run over to the white building in front of you. Go inside the church, and the briefcase is on the pew on the right-hand side, next to the skeleton, in front of you.

From the spawn above, face east and exit the church. Follow the path and stop when you reach the main road. Turn left and follow the road until you reach the white “33” sign. Turn right and walk to the bridge. On your left is a concrete viewing platform and an orange metal cart. Walk over to the cart, and the briefcase is inside it.

From the spawn in location, run over to the white building in front of you and stop at the green dumpster on the corner. The building is missing its roof, so be careful not to fall through when you jump up onto it. Face South and walk along the edge of the building. Jump over the wall, land on the other side, and still facing South, walk up the ramp in front of you. Keep going until you reach the hole in the roof. Drop through the hole and, if you lined it up properly, the briefcase will be right in front of you on the metal shelf.

From the spawn above, face north and walk forward, veering left to get around the roof. Keep heading north until you’re standing at the base of the Super Duper Mart sign in the car park.

Face northwest, walk forward, and follow the road until you reach the bus stop on your right. Turn north and walk around behind the wall of the bus stop. The briefcase is to the right of the green dumpster, leaning against the wall.

From the spawn above, jump onto the bus shelter and face northeast. Run straight until you reach a dirt wall. Climb up onto the ground above and keep heading northeast. You’ll see a junk pile vein in front of you. The briefcase is in the middle of the junk pile, next to the blue oven.
From the spawn above, face northeast and walk up the hill to the white house on your left. The briefcase is on the front porch, next to a wooden crate and a skeleton.

From the spawn above, face South and run over to the ruined house. Jump over the wall, and you should land in the basement. Face West, and the briefcase will be in the bathtub, next to the green ammo box.

From the spawn above, walk back up the stairs, face North, and jump over the wall. Head back to the white house and jump onto the roof. Face North and you’ll see a grey house and a shed in front of you. Run down the hill toward the shed on the left.

Go inside the shed and follow it around to the end. The briefcase is on the bench at the far end.

From the spawn above, exit the shed and climb onto the roof. Face West and run straight until you’re standing in the middle of the riverbed. Turn north and follow the riverbed under the stone bridge, stopping at the small boat in the center.

Face northeast and you’ll see a rusty ute/pickup truck reversing a boat into the river. The briefcase is in that boat, at the end closest to you.

From the spawn above, face northwest and run forward until you reach the main road. Turn right and follow it over the train tracks and around the bend until you reach the boat hire shed at the end. Head inside. The briefcase is just inside the second door, on the ground next to the Nuka-Cola machine.

From the spawn above, exit the building, face North, and walk down to the water’s edge. Follow the shoreline with the water on your right. Keep going until you reach the white capsized boat. The briefcase will be on top of the boat, at the end.

From the spawn above, continue following the shoreline with the water on your right. Stop when you reach the raft in the water. Face North and run up the hill. Go inside the red trailer and turn left. The briefcase is under the dresser on your left.

Level 0 Locked Door

From the spawn above, face South and run until you reach the train tracks. Turn east and follow the tracks over the red metal bridge, then stop at the white lookout tower on your right. Go around and enter the tower via the stairs. The briefcase is leaning against the wooden desk along the northern wall.

From the spawn above, exit the building and walk back to the train tracks. Follow the tracks East until you reach a dead end. The briefcase is inside the collapsed tunnel, in front of you, against the right-hand wall.

Might want to keep an eye on the Radhog spawns here as well.

From the spawn above, turn around and follow the train tracks back until you reach the three blue train carriages. Climb onto the top of the first carriage and face southeast. You’ll see a red toolbox inside a cave ahead. Run over and enter the cave. The briefcase is on the rocks along the southern side.

From the spawn above, exit the cave, face South, and climb up onto the rocks. Run forward and make your way onto the roof of the house ahead. Keep facing South and you’ll see a small red shed on your left. Head over and go inside. The briefcase is on top of the metal barrel on your left.

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof and face southeast. Run forward and stop at the edge of the cliff. There’s a small shed below you. Drop down to the ground and go through the door on your left. The briefcase is on your left, just inside the doorway next to a skeleton.

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof of the building, face south, and run forward. Go past the two dinosaurs and slow down when you see the building ahead. Veer right and head toward the green dumpster on the corner. The briefcase is inside the dumpster.

From the spawn above, jump up onto the roof, face east, and follow the roof to the end. Turn toward the northeast and run forward toward the back of the park. Stop at the triceratops and face east. Walk over to the right side of the food stall and turn north. The briefcase is inside the fridge that’s blocking the doorway.

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof of the food stall and face east. Run up the hill while staying on an east line, and you’ll see a white building at the top. Adjust your path and enter the small church. The briefcase is on the left side, under the last pew at the back of the church, near the door.

From the spawn in location, face south, turn left, and follow the road past the blue car on your right and the Nuka Cola machine on your left. Stop at the green car on your right. Face west and walk over to the bus shelter. The briefcase is on your left, leaning against the wall of the shelter.

From the spawn above, jump onto the bus shelter and face southeast. Run forward (for a long time) until you reach the white and green trailer. Walk around to the other side and go inside. Turn left, and the briefcase is under the bed in front of you.
This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

From the spawn above, exit the trailer and jump onto the roof. Face southwest and you’ll see the outdoor cinema screen in the distance. Run over to the screen and stop at the small tin shed along the chain link fence. Walk around the shed to find the door. Go inside, and the briefcase is on the metal cabinet against the northern wall.

From the spawn above, exit the shed and walk around to the front of the screen. Face west and run over to the ticket building. Jump onto the roof on the right side and open the door on your left. Face south, and the briefcase is on your right, next to the green chair.

From the spawn above, exit the building, face west, and run out to the main road. Turn left and follow the road until you reach the large billboard on your left. Use the tree on your right to climb up onto the billboard platform. Follow the platform around, and the briefcase is at the end.

From the spawn in location, face north and run forward until you reach the metal trailer with the blue and white awning. Turn west and walk forward until you reach the picnic table. Veer right and go down the stairs. At the bottom of the stairs, face south. The briefcase will be under the bench on your left.

From the spawn above, face east and walk back up the wooden path to the end. Keep facing east and walk over to the metal trailer on the right. Go inside and turn right. The briefcase is in the open safe on your right.

From the spawn above, exit the trailer, face south, and walk forward a few meters until you reach the dirt road. Follow the dirt road to the main road. Turn right and keep following the road until it curves and you see a large section of fencing missing on your left. Stand in the middle of the gap and face southeast. If you look up the hill you’ll see a faint path. Run up the hill, keeping as close to a south-east line as you can, until you reach a clearing on your left with a shelter entrance, a skeleton, and a smoking pipe. The briefcase is next to the skeleton.
From the spawn above, face southwest and run forward until you reach the “Welcome to Ohio” sign. Turn to face north, and the briefcase is on the back of the car, half-glitched into it.

From the spawn above, face west and run straight until you reach the ruined house. Jump over the back wall on the right and turn left. The briefcase is at the top of the stairs, against the back wall.

From the spawn above, face west and look up the hill. You’ll see a large white church. Run up the hill and go in through the front door. Walk to the back of the church and stop at the podium. Turn left, and the briefcase is on the metal shelf in front of you.

From the spawn above, turn around and exit the church. Face southeast and run down the hill to the main road. Face south and follow the road past the “Buckeye Diner” sign on your right, then stop at the “South 7” sign on your right. Stand with your back to the sign, facing roughly east, and walk straight ahead. The briefcase is at the base of the first dark tree in front of you. There is a fixed spawn of Radhogs here, which should help you to find the tree and the briefcase.

From the spawn above, face southeast and walk forward until you reach the edge of the cliff. Look down and you’ll see a mostly buried red building in front of you, with a paddock and wooden fencing on your right. Jump off the ledge and walk over to the red building. The briefcase is at the front, half buried under the rubble next to a red wheelbarrow.

From the spawn in location, run over to the red and silver truck trailer on the left side of the Red Rocket building. Stop at the front of the truck and face north. Walk over and open the door in front of you. Go inside and walk behind the counter. Face south, and the briefcase is on the shelf behind the counter.

From the spawn above, face east and walk around to the front of the counter. Face north and walk out the door in front of you. Turn left and follow the building until you reach the garage button on the wall. Press the button and wait for the garage door to open. Face south and go inside the garage. The briefcase is in the far left corner of the room, sitting on top of a metal cart.

From the spawn above, exit the garage, face west, and walk over to the white and blue trailer. Stop at the pile of tyres near the front door and face south. Walk forward and jump over the chain link fence. Veer slightly right and keep walking until you reach the temporary shooting range. The briefcase is on your left, near the front wheel of the green rusty truck, leaning against a wooden crate.

From the spawn above, face west and run forward until you reach the dried river bed. Stand in the middle of the river bed and face north. Follow the river bed past the raider checkpoints on your right and stop at the broken wooden bridge. Face west and jump up onto what’s left of the bridge. The briefcase is on the edge of the bridge in front of you.

From the spawn above, face south and follow the river bed all the way down until you reach the green metal bridge. The briefcase is on your left, inside a tipped-over shopping trolley near some brain fungus.

From the spawn in location, run straight ahead toward the ruined brick building beside the red truck trailer. Go around the right side and jump up onto the second floor. Face east and follow the room around to your left. Open the wooden door. The briefcase is on top of the filing cabinets along the north wall.

From the spawn above, face south and walk to the edge of the second floor. Turn to face southeast and you’ll see a white house with a red front door across the road. Walk over to the house and go around it until you find the red door on the right side of the building, not the front door. Go inside and take the stairs to the top floor. At the top of the stairs, face south. The briefcase is on the metal shelf in front of you.
From the spawn in location, run over to the red and white barn in front of you. Go inside and face east. The briefcase is on the wooden table between the locker and the hay bale.

From the spawn above, face south and exit the barn through the back door. Keep heading south toward the paddock behind the barn. When you’re standing in the middle of the paddock, face east and walk over to the white horse trailer on your right. The briefcase is on the ground at the back of the trailer.

From the spawn above, jump onto the trailer and face south. Run forward until you reach a small pond filled with water. On the left side of the pond is a cave. Go inside and face east. The briefcase is on a rock shelf toward the back of the cave.

From the spawn above, exit the cave and face southwest. Run forward and stop in the middle of the dried river bed near the fort. Face southeast and run until you reach the small campsite with the blue canvas tents. The briefcase is next to the tent on the right, beside the orange metal cart, leaning against the wooden crates.

From the spawn above, face west and run forward. Cross the bridge and turn southwest. Walk over to the red canoes on your left. The briefcase is on the canoe on the far left, at the bottom of the rack.

Level 1 Locked Door

From the spawn above, jump on top of the canoe at the top and face west. You’ll see a path leading up to the fort between the rock walls. Follow the path up and jump the fence into the fort. Keep heading west and follow the path between the two buildings. Stop at the end of the path and turn north. Walk forward and jump over the railing of the building in front of you. Take a few steps forward and unlock the door on your right. Go inside, follow the hallway around, and open the office door. The briefcase is under the desk on your left.

From the spawn above, turn around and exit the building. On your left, there’s a wagon and some display cases. Stand on the display cases at the end and face south. Walk forward, veering slightly right, and go through the gateway in the wall. Keep heading south and jump over the wall in front of you. Look down, and the briefcase will be on your left, leaning against a pile of sandbags.

From the spawn above, face west and run forward. Keep going and jump the fence until you’re outside the fort and standing in the middle of the car park. Turn north and walk forward, past the small building, and stop at the main road leading up to the fort. Turn left, walk forward, and the briefcase is on your left, leaning against the sign behind the skull robot light.

From the spawn above, face south and follow the dirt road all the way out to the main road. Turn left at the Abraxodyne trailer and follow the road east. Jump over the guard railing and stop on the roof of the trailer. Look down and you’ll see four blue and white tables with umbrellas. The briefcase is next to the table on the left.

From the spawn above, jump back on top of the trailer and face south. Run forward, veer slightly right, and keep heading up the road. Stop when you see the red, blue, and orange shipping containers on your left. Turn left and you’ll see a ramp leading up the scaffolding at the far end of the containers. Head up the ramp and climb all the way to the very top. Face west, and the briefcase is at the end of the platform in front of you.

From the spawn above, face east and walk to the end of the platform. Turn south and look down. You’ll see a black-roofed shed on the ground below. Jump over the railing and land on the roof. Face south, step off the roof, then turn around so you’re facing the door. Open the door, go inside the shed, and the briefcase is in front of you on a metal cabinet.

From the spawn in location, face north and run over to the green forklift. Turn northeast and run over to the red shed in front of you. Face north, and the briefcase is leaning against the weapons workbench on your left.

From the spawn above, face east and run forward until you reach the main road. Turn southeast and run past the ruined house, stopping at the windmill behind it. Face south, jump the fence, and walk forward slowly. The briefcase is half buried in the field on your right, just past the phosphate deposit.

From the spawn above, face west and run straight until you reach the main road. Turn south and follow the road all the way to the end. Go past the house and enter the collapsed tunnel in front of you. The briefcase is inside the rusty car on your left.
This briefcase does not exist in the game files.
This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

From the spawn above, face north and follow the road until you reach a car accident with Abraxo barrels and red powder all over the ground. Jump onto the back of the rusty green ute/pick up truck, and the briefcase is in the left corner of the tray.

From the spawn above, face north and follow the road past the police car, then past the cream and green rusty car on your left. Stop at the third car in front of you. Jump onto the bonnet of that car and face east. Run forward, veering slightly left. Stop at the edge of the cliff and look down. You’ll see a black-roofed shed on your left on the other side of the fence. Jump the fence and find the door of the shed. Go inside, and the briefcase is on the ground in front of you, leaning against some wooden crates.

From the spawn above, turn toward the hill on your left and run up until you reach the main road. Face north and follow the road, past the giant bucket on your right, and stop at the white gravel road on your right. Turn right and follow the path down to the covered bridge. The briefcase is in the back of the van on your right.

From the spawn in location, face north and follow the dirt path. Stop at the bus shelter on your left and jump onto the roof. Turn toward the right-hand side of the fence line in front of you and look down. Count three fence panels from the right. Behind the third panel is a tree stump. Jump down and run over to the stump. The briefcase is under it, next to a skeleton and a shovel.

From the spawn above, face northwest and run over to the van in front of you. Jump onto the roof. Face west and you’ll see a blue van ahead of you on the right (and no, it’s not a player’s survival tent). Run over to the van and find the door. Go inside and turn left. The briefcase is on the bench at the end.

From the spawn above, exit the van, face north, and run back to the main dirt road. Face west and follow the road. Stop at the motorbikes on your left. The briefcase is leaning against the front wheel of the first motorbike on your left.
